name: Workspaces
description: Hyprland workspaces: persistent 1-5, click to focus, scroll to walk; scratchpads as stars when turned on; each monitor's own 1-0 with haseen toggle monitor-workspaces

persistent.description: Workspaces 1..N always shown, even when empty (0-10); with per-monitor workspaces, the monitor's own first N

scratchpads.description: Show each scratchpad (special workspace, such as the SUPER + GRAVE console) as a star after the workspaces; click one to show or hide it

allMonitors.description: Show non-persistent workspaces from every monitor, not just this bar's screen (ignored with per-monitor workspaces, where each bar shows its own)
